title: kernel.answers.receive@1 (decision kind, floor local, safety grant): bound args
description: Let this session receive typed answers from your Hitch clients (inventory K20, Haystack P5). A Claude session's mod pairs with the node for one channel only: the service delivering into that session's vouched queue an answer the person typed and a Hitch client already decided (queue.question@1's answer, HAYSTACK-SEAMS A1). It replaces v2's mod pairing Allowed on the Dashboard (read-only from P5) for this use alone. NORMATIVE: a pairing made by this kind is never a person principal. The node's isUser is false for it; its key can't sign a person's request (USER_SIG), an answer MAC or any /hitch/v1 answer (not_a_client); it opens no channel but the vouched answer queue. Only a mod that declares the answers.receive capability may ask (today the Inbox mod); the node refuses any other at request. Bound to the session's key fingerprint (`keyFp`, sha256 of the X25519 public key it sent), the `mod` and `session`, the `code` that session shows, and the `scope`. A safety kind: no grant answers it and no always-allow. Expires with the ask (`expires`, onExpire withdraw). Preview rows: Mod, Session, Project, Code, Key, What it allows ('typed answers from your Hitch clients will reach this machine's Claude session'). Options: approve 'Allow' (local, presence), decline 'Deny' (narrow).
